name: T-80BVM
protection: Composite + Relikt ERA, rear slat armour. Game: hull and turret immune to all small-calibre and to 7.62x54R/12.7/14.5 mm (those only break optics, searchlights, external MGs and track pins). Kills need launchers: Javelin/NLAW top-attack, AT4/MAAWS/SMAW or RPG-7 PG-7V to side, rear or roof; frontal ERA defeats single-charge PG-7V.
visual_notes: Gas-turbine tank: flat rear deck with large exhaust grille, distinctive high-pitched whine (audio)
6 road wheels per side (smaller, rubber-tyred) with 5 return rollers - tell-tale versus T-72's 3
Turret similar to T-72B with Relikt ERA, Sosna-U sight on the roof
2026: welded anti-drone roof cage, netting, sometimes covered superstructure; Arctic/Northern units in winter wash

colour_schemes.name: Russian protective green with white Z/V/triangle ID marks
